title: A missing release of backend receiver sessions in the Ad Hoc Transfer component of Progress Software WS_FTP Server…
description: A resource management flaw exists in the Ad Hoc Transfer component of Progress Software WS_FTP Server on Windows, where backend receiver sessions are not properly released. This issue affects versions prior to 2024.0.7 and 2025.0.4 and can cause server resource exhaustion leading to service degradation.
